nativeCodeNotes.finding: Clearinghouse AI triggers only when damage exceeds Runner grip, aims at max hand size plus one advancement and rezzes at Runner end-of-turn timing.

Known Clearinghouse adds a threat value based on advancement counters. Unknown advanced remotes use generic heuristic; more than three advancement counters are valued less highly than one to three. This is a possible policy limitation, not a demonstrated cause of the result.
